acceptance_criteria.criterion: A LedgerStore constructed from a project path resolves storageDir to {ledgerRoot}/{repoName}/{slug}/
renameSlug('new-slug') moves the directory to {ledgerRoot}/{repoName}/new-slug/, not the flat {ledgerRoot}/new-slug/
The conflict-check access() call inside renameSlug() queries {ledgerRoot}/{repoName}/new-slug/
All existing LedgerStore unit tests pass with updated path expectations

summary: Added `deriveRepoName` to LedgerStore import from ledger-root.ts
Added `public readonly repoName: string` field to LedgerStore
Updated LedgerStore constructor: computes `this.repoName = deriveRepoName(projectPath)` and sets `this.storageDir = join(this.ledgerRoot, this.repoName, this.slug)`
Updated `renameSlug()`: `newStorageDir` now uses `join(this.ledgerRoot, this.repoName, newSlug)` for both the directory move and the conflict-check access() call

Updated `listAllProjects()` to scan two levels deep: depth-1 dirs with a direct .meta.json are read as old-layout projects; depth-1 dirs without .meta.json are treated as repo-namespace dirs and scanned for slug dirs at depth 2

Updated all renameSlug test path assertions in ledger-store.test.ts to use `store.repoName` as the namespace level (e.g. `join(tempLedgerRoot, store.repoName, NEW_SLUG)` instead of `join(tempLedgerRoot, NEW_SLUG)`)
Added new storageDir isolation test: two LedgerStore instances with the same slug but different project paths produce different storageDir values and correctly named repoName fields

All 63 ledger-store.test.ts tests pass; 63 GUI handler tests in api.test.ts/api-reset.test.ts/api-wp-overview.test.ts are expected regressions — the GUI handlers construct LedgerStore(slug, ledgerRoot) with a bare slug which will be addressed in WP-004/WP-005

comments.note: gui/api.ts constructs LedgerStore(slug, ledgerRoot) with a bare slug on every handler call (17 instances, e.g. lines 172, 349, 517, etc.). After the WP-002 storageDir change, bare-slug construction always yields repoName='unknown', so all handlers look in {ledgerRoot}/unknown/{slug}/. This is a systematic pattern issue: handlers need to resolve the plan_path via listAllProjects first, then construct LedgerStore with the full planPath. WP-004/WP-005 must address this before the GUI tests pass again.

The listAllProjects() two-level scan introduced in WP-002 will emit stderr noise for depth-1 entries that are repo-namespace dirs (they have no .meta.json and the catch is silent). WP-004 should add a targeted test for the stderr log path to ensure the error format stays consistent for actual missing-meta project dirs at depth 2.

summary: AC1 verified: LedgerStore constructor sets storageDir = join(ledgerRoot, repoName, slug) — confirmed in source at ledger-store.ts constructor.
AC2 verified: renameSlug() computes newStorageDir = join(ledgerRoot, repoName, newSlug) and passes it to rename() — flat-layout path is not used.
AC3 verified: The conflict-check access() call uses the same newStorageDir (includes repoName) — TOCTOU pattern is unchanged from prior behaviour.
AC4 verified: All 63 ledger-store.test.ts tests pass (including new storageDir isolation test).

Regression confirmed: Exactly 63 GUI handler tests fail in api.test.ts, api-reset.test.ts, api-wp-overview.test.ts — matches expected regressions documented in handoff. Root cause: gui/api.ts constructs LedgerStore(slug, ledgerRoot) without a full planPath, yielding repoName='unknown'. Scoped to WP-004/WP-005.

Edge-case note: deriveRepoName() guards empty/null input and non-slug repo names with 'unknown' fallback — safe. TOCTOU race in renameSlug() between access() and rename() is a pre-existing pattern, not introduced by this WP.

comments.note: deriveRepoName() returns 'unknown' for any repo whose directory name doesn't match SAFE_SLUG_REGEX. If two such repos exist, their projects will share the {ledgerRoot}/unknown/ namespace and can collide by slug. Worth documenting as a known limitation in constraints.md.
No improvement — core logic is clean and consistent with AC specification.

[documentation-forward] constraints.md should document the known limitation: when two repos have a directory name that fails SAFE_SLUG_REGEX (e.g. contains dots or non-ASCII), both fall back to the 'unknown/' namespace and can collide by slug. Add a Known Limitations entry with: affected component (LedgerStore.storageDir), trigger condition, and mitigation advice (rename repo root to a slug-compatible name).

[documentation-forward] LedgerStore.listAllProjects() two-level scan behavior (old flat-layout detection at depth-1, repo-namespace scan at depth-2) is not directly tested — only exercised indirectly through detectProjectByCwd tests. Consider adding a direct listAllProjects test suite in a future WP that covers: mixed flat+namespaced layout in the same ledger root, stderr log path for missing depth-2 .meta.json files.

renameSlug() conflict test creates a conflictStore using join(tmpdir(), NEW_SLUG) as plan path, which produces repoName='unknown' (shallow path fallback). The test works correctly because store also uses a shallow path and gets 'unknown'. Future test refactors that use proper {root}/docs/agents/plans/{slug} paths should ensure conflictStore's plan path derives the same repoName as store for the conflict assertion to remain valid.
